changelog: Label unidentifiable tracks "Unrated" (final fallback, configurable) so nothing is left blank; rate all artists TV-G to keep artist browsing working when "block unrecognized rating" is on (documented workaround); expose album rating, album-inheritance, and artist rating as toggles.
description: Fills in missing parental ratings for music (Deezer), movies & shows (TMDb), and anime (MyAnimeList) so parental controls work across the whole library.
name: Chaperone
overview: Automatic parental ratings across music, movies, shows, and anime.
